migrationNotes: The source page carries almost no body text: a banner, a Full Results button, the two Bowler of the Tournament graphics, the line 'Check out the results of each event clicking on the banners below', and seven event banners that link to anchors on the full-results page.

The venue and date shown for each event card were read off the event banner artwork itself, not from page text. The Men's Singles and Women's Singles banners do not state a venue legibly, so those cards carry no meta line.

Squarespace linked each banner to an anchor on the full-results page (#swmenrinks, #swpairsmen, #swmenssingles, #rinks, #swpairs, #swsingles, #getaway). Our page template has no anchor targets, so every card links to the top of /2025-southwest-open-full-results.
All images were already rescued into photos/archive/2025/ by the earlier archive pass and are referenced there; nothing was downloaded twice.
A /2025-southwest-open rewrite still needs adding to vercel.json — outside the scope of this migration pass.
